name: A Fortitude Venomancer in Beetle Form gets the tank stance melee crit reduction
contract: Venomancer Beetle Form (803183) applies the tank aura 807726 in every specialization, but only Fortitude (ChrSpecs 52, identity Exposed Flesh 92144) is the tank spec, so the tank stance crit reduction 991293 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_MELEE_CRIT_CHANCE -6) requires both Beetle Form and Fortitude. Spider Lord (704264, helper 805139) augments Beetle Form, keeps 807726 and therefore keeps 991293. Stalking (53) chains entry 12201, Fortitude chains 31202.

steps.label: Let login hooks and class synchronisation settle
SETUP: Stalking does not know Exposed Flesh
SETUP: Beetle Form applies its tank aura in Stalking
Beetle Form outside Fortitude gives no crit reduction
SETUP: Beetle Form applies its tank aura in Fortitude
Beetle Form in Fortitude grants the crit reduction
SETUP: leaving Beetle Form removes its tank aura
Fortitude outside Beetle Form gives no crit reduction
Re-entering Beetle Form in Fortitude grants the crit reduction again
SETUP: Spider Lord applies its Beetle Form helper
Spider Lord keeps the Beetle Form tank aura
Spider Lord keeps the crit reduction
SETUP: leaving Fortitude removes Exposed Flesh
Leaving Fortitude removes the crit reduction
